steps: This is our house. It's very big! Our living room is beautiful. It's blue and green. My sister's bedroom is pink. It's not very nice. My bedroom is blue. It's very nice!
problems.answer: This is our house. It's very big! Our living room is beautiful. It's blue and green. My sister's bedroom is pink. It's not very nice. My bedroom is blue. It's very nice!

chapters.title: Further Writing Practice. Paragraphs

problems.condition: Further Writing Practice. Paragraphs, упр. 1, с. 88. Соотнеси время дня A–C с действиями 1–3.
Further Writing Practice. Paragraphs, упр. 2, с. 88. Раздели текст о субботе Марка на абзацы.
steps: Абзац 1 (утро): Mark's favourite day is Saturday. He gets up at nine o'clock. In the morning he has breakfast, then he goes to the park.
Абзац 2 (день): In the afternoon Mark watches TV. He plays computer games too.
Абзац 3 (вечер): Then, at ten o'clock, Mark goes to bed. Saturdays are great fun for Mark!
problems.answer: Три абзаца: утро (gets up, has breakfast, goes to the park), день (watches TV, plays computer games), вечер (goes to bed at ten).

problems.condition: Further Writing Practice. Paragraphs, упр. 3, с. 88. Напиши по плану, что ты обычно делаешь каждый день.
steps: Пример: In the morning I get up at eight o'clock, have breakfast and go to school. In the afternoon I walk my dog and play computer games. In the evening I have supper and watch TV. Then, at ten o'clock, I go to bed.
problems.answer: In the morning I get up at eight, have breakfast and go to school. In the afternoon I walk my dog and play computer games. In the evening I have supper, and at ten o'clock I go to bed.

chapters.title: Further Speaking Practice. Talking about household chores

problems.condition: Further Speaking Practice. Household chores, упр. 1, с. 90. Скажи классу, что из этого ты делаешь по дому и как часто (always / sometimes / never).
steps: I always wash the dishes. I never mop the floor. I sometimes vacuum the carpet. I always make my bed.
I sometimes do the shopping. I always make tea. I never water the plants. I sometimes make breakfast.
problems.answer: I always wash the dishes and make my bed. I sometimes vacuum the carpet, do the shopping and make breakfast. I never mop the floor or water the plants.

problems.condition: Further Speaking Practice. Household chores, упр. 2, с. 90. Прочитай диалог по ролям.
steps: Vadim: Alina, do you help with the chores at home? Alina: Yes, I do. I sometimes wash the dishes after lunch, and on Sundays I always make breakfast for Mum and Dad. What about you? Vadim: I always make my bed, but I never wash the dishes!
problems.answer: — Do you help with the chores? — Yes. I sometimes wash the dishes, and on Sundays I always make breakfast. What about you? — I always make my bed, but I never wash the dishes!

problems.condition: Further Speaking Practice. Household chores, упр. 3, с. 90. В парах разыграйте похожие диалоги.
